sources.entry: WindowHop - Window switcher that gives every open window its own tile and switches to the exact one you pick, across Spaces and displays.

summary.one_liner: WindowHop is a native macOS window switcher that gives every open window its own tile so you can jump to the exact window you pick, including windows on other Spaces and displays.
summary.what_it_does: WindowHop replaces the macOS Cmd+Tab behavior, which switches between apps, with a switcher that shows one tile per window. Holding Cmd and pressing Tab cycles through windows, and releasing Cmd switches to the selected one, including windows on another Space or display. The switcher can show large app icons (default) or live previews of each window, which are captured only while the switcher is open and kept in memory. Alt+Tab opens a switcher that stays open until a window is chosen or Esc is pressed. Settings cover shortcuts, switcher contents (minimized windows, hidden apps, Picture in Picture, other Spaces and displays), and the display the switcher opens on. The README also describes closing a window from the switcher with Delete and falling back to Apple's switcher when WindowHop is not running.
use_cases: switch between many browser windows or terminal windows
jump to a window on another macOS Space or display
replace Cmd+Tab app switching with per-window switching
preview windows before switching to them
install a free open source window switcher on a Mac
how_to_run: Download WindowHop-.dmg from the latest release and drag WindowHop to Applications
Open WindowHop and grant Accessibility permission in System Settings
Hold Cmd and press Tab to open the switcher
notable: One tile per window, so a window with ten tabs is a single tile
Optional live window previews, captured in memory only and never saved to disk
Alt+Tab mode keeps the switcher open without holding a key
Falls back to Apple's Cmd+Tab switcher when WindowHop is not running
Derived from AltTab with its history kept
caveats: Requires Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 26 or later
Needs Accessibility permission, and Screen Recording for window previews
Windows on a Space not visited since WindowHop started are not listed yet
English only; tab counts only for apps using standard macOS tabs
